initialize.instructions:
codesearch — semantic code search + symbol impact analysis.

WHEN TO USE codesearch (prefer over grep/glob):
  Good for: semantic or cross-file lookup, unknown file paths, symbol navigation,
    "where is X implemented", "find usages of Y", "how does Z flow through the code"
  Not for: a single known file (just read it), trivial one-line edits,
    exact literal patterns where plain grep is faster

SERVICE-MODE NOTES (codesearch serve, esp. on another host):
  - Paths come from the SERVER's filesystem. Use get_chunk to read content;
    don't try to open returned paths locally.
  - Not every directory is indexed (e.g. .venv, node_modules, build/). If a
    search returns nothing, the dir may be unindexed — ask, don't grep blindly.

PICK THE RIGHT TOOL FOR THE TASK:
  "who calls X?" / "what breaks if I rename X?"
    → find_impact (C# via SCIP; other languages: use find kind="usages")
  "find code about X" / "how does X work" / "show me X"
    → search(mode="semantic") — concepts + synonyms + identifiers
  exact syntax like Vec<T> / foo = null / a::b
    → search(mode="literal", regex=true) — patterns semantic can't match
  "where is X defined?" / "what does file X import?"
    → find(kind="definition" | "imports")
  "show all symbols in file X" / "code like chunk Y"
    → explore(kind="outline" | "similar")
  read chunk content → get_chunk(chunk_id)
  index health / repo list → status

RULES:
  - search(semantic) is the DEFAULT for code lookup. Don't skip it.
  - find_impact for C# refactors; find(kind="usages") for other languages.
  - NEVER use literal as first search unless you need exact syntax.
  - project or group is REQUIRED in multi-repo mode.

Mode: self-contained (stdio)
Project: <REPOSITORY_ROOT>
Database: <REPOSITORY_ROOT>/.codesearch.db (ready)
Model: minilm-l6-q (384d)

tools.name: explore
tools.description:
Unified code exploration. Set `kind` to choose the action:

- `outline` (default): list all indexed top-level symbols in a file — kind, signature, and line range. Set `target` to a file path.
- `similar`: find chunks semantically similar to a given chunk by its ID. Set `target` to the chunk_id (as string).

IMPORTANT (multi-repo): always specify either `project` (single repo) or `group` (cross-repo). Omitting both in multi-repo mode returns a `scope_required` error with the list of available projects and groups. If the user has not indicated which repository to search, ask them to choose.

group.description: Route to all projects in a group (requires `codesearch serve`).

limit.description: Maximum number of results (default: 5 for similar, unlimited for outline).

project.description: Route to a specific project (requires `codesearch serve`).

target.description:
File path for outline mode, or chunk_id for similar mode.
For outline: a file path relative to project root or absolute.
For similar: a numeric chunk_id.

tools.name: find
tools.description:
Unified symbol navigation. Set `kind` to choose the action:

- `definition` (default): locate where a symbol is defined (function, class, struct, etc.)
- `usages`: find all call-sites and references to a symbol
- `imports`: list all imports/dependencies declared in a file (set `symbol` to the file path)
- `dependents`: find all files that import or depend on a module, file, or symbol

For `imports`, set `symbol` to a file path. For other kinds, `symbol` is the symbol name.

IMPORTANT (multi-repo): always specify either `project` (single repo) or `group` (cross-repo). Omitting both in multi-repo mode returns a `scope_required` error with the list of available projects and groups. If the user has not indicated which repository to search, ask them to choose.

inputSchema.description:
Unified symbol navigation request — replaces `find_definition`, `find_usages`,
`find_imports`, and `find_dependents`.

definition_kind.description:
Optional kind filter for definitions.
Accepted: "Function" | "Class" | "Method" | "Struct" | "Trait" | "Enum" | "TypeAlias" | "Interface"

group.description: Route to all projects in a group (requires `codesearch serve`).

project.description: Route to a specific project (requires `codesearch serve`).

symbol.description: Symbol name (for definition/usages) or module path (for imports/dependents).

inputSchema.title: FindRequest

tools.name: find_impact
tools.description:
Symbol impact analysis — find all references to a symbol with IDE-class precision (SCIP).

Returns transitive call-sites with file/line precision, enabling agents to plan refactors without missing a caller. More accurate than text-based `find kind="usages"` because it understands the language semantics.

Input variants:
- By name: `{ "symbol_name": "FieldDefinition.Validate", "project": "myrepo" }`
- By position: `{ "file": "src/Validation/FieldDefinition.cs", "line": 42, "project": "myrepo" }`

Languages: C# today (requires the `scip-csharp` helper, bundled in `-with-csharp` releases). For Rust/Python/Go/etc., use `find` with `kind="usages"` as a text-based fallback until SCIP backends for those languages ship.

IMPORTANT (multi-repo): always specify `project` (single repo). Omitting `project` in multi-repo mode returns a `scope_required` error.

inputSchema.description:
Symbol impact analysis request — returns transitive call-sites of a symbol
with file/line precision, using language-specific semantic analysis (SCIP).

Input variants:
- By name: `{ "symbol_name": "FieldDefinition.Validate", "project": "myrepo" }`
- By position: `{ "file": "src/Validation/FieldDefinition.cs", "line": 42, "project": "myrepo" }`

file.description:
File path for position-based lookup (relative to project root or absolute).
Must be combined with `line`.

group.description: Route to all projects in a group (requires `codesearch serve`).

language.description:
Language filter (e.g. `"csharp"`). If omitted, auto-detects from file extension
or searches all installed language adapters.

line.description:
1-based line number for position-based lookup.
Must be combined with `file`.

project.description: Route to a specific project (requires `codesearch serve`).

symbol_name.description:
Symbol name to look up (e.g. `"FieldDefinition.Validate"`).
Used when you know the name. Mutually exclusive with `file`+`line`.

inputSchema.title: FindImpactRequest

tools.name: get_chunk
tools.description:
Retrieve the full content of a specific chunk by its ID, plus optional surrounding lines for context.
Use this after search or explore to read the actual code without loading the whole file.

USE FOR: reading a specific function/class body after finding it via search.
Set context_lines (default 0, max 20) to include lines before and after the chunk.

IMPORTANT (multi-repo): chunk_ids are local to each repository and are NOT globally unique.
When `project` is omitted in multi-repo mode, the tool scans all repositories for the chunk_id.
If found in exactly one repo, it is returned automatically. If found in multiple repos, an `ambiguous_chunk_id` error lists the candidates so you can retry with `project`.

inputSchema.description: Request to fetch a chunk by ID

chunk_id.description: Local chunk id. Ignored when `chunk_ref` is set (federated fetch).

chunk_ref.description:
Federated chunk reference `"<peer>/<remote_alias>:<chunk_id>"`
(e.g. `"cloud/inriver:12345"`), as returned verbatim in a remote search
result's `chunk_ref`. The `<remote_alias>` segment scopes the fetch to a
single remote project so the multi-repo peer can disambiguate the
chunk_id. When set, the chunk is fetched from the named remote peer and
`chunk_id`/`project`/`group` are ignored. (A legacy `"<peer>:<chunk_id>"`
ref without an alias is still accepted for backward compatibility.)

inputSchema.title: GetChunkRequest

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Unified code search. Set `mode` to choose the backend:

- `semantic` (default): vector embeddings + BM25 FTS + exact-identifier boosting, fused with RRF. Best for conceptual queries, identifier lookups, and mixed natural-language + symbol queries.
- `literal`: pure FTS, no embeddings. Fast and works without an embedding model. Sub-mode selection:
  * Queries with operators, brackets, or punctuation (`foo = null`, `Vec<T>`, `return x;`, `a::b`) -> set `regex=true` and write the query as a regex. BM25 tokenizes on punctuation otherwise, producing noisy results.
  * Multi-word exact phrases -> set `phrase=true`.
  * Plain identifier lookups (`CodesearchService`) -> leave both false.

For semantic mode, optionally set `semantic_mode`: "auto" (default) | "semantic" | "lexical" | "hybrid".
Returns metadata only by default (`compact=true`). Use `get_chunk` to read full code. Prefer `search(mode="literal", regex=true)` over external grep/ripgrep for code patterns.

IMPORTANT (multi-repo): always specify either `project` (single repo) or `group` (cross-repo). Omitting both in multi-repo mode returns a `scope_required` error with the list of available projects and groups. If the user has not indicated which repository to search, ask them to choose.

inputSchema.description:
Unified search request — replaces `semantic_search` and `literal_search`.

Set `mode` to choose the search backend:
- `"semantic"` (default) — vector embeddings + BM25 FTS + exact-identifier boosting, fused with RRF.
- `"literal"` — pure FTS, no embeddings. Supports regex, phrase, and exact-term matching.

compact.description:
Return compact results (metadata only) to save tokens (default: true).
Only applies in semantic mode.

filter_path.description: Only return results from files under this path prefix (semantic mode).

format.description: Output format for literal mode: `"json"` (default) or `"grep"`.

group.description: Route to all projects in a group (requires `codesearch serve`).

limit.description: Maximum number of results (default: 10 for semantic, 20 for literal).

phrase.description: Treat `query` as a phrase (literal mode only).

project.description: Route to a specific project (requires `codesearch serve`).

query.description: The search query (natural language, code snippet, regex, or exact term).

regex.description: Treat `query` as a regex pattern (literal mode only).

semantic_mode.description:
Override auto-detection of query intent (semantic mode only).
`"auto"` (default) | `"semantic"` | `"lexical"` | `"hybrid"`

inputSchema.title: SearchRequest

tools.name: status
tools.description:
Unified status/info tool. Set `kind` to choose the action:

- `index` (default): get the status of the local search index (model info, chunk count, readiness)
- `projects`: list all registered projects/repositories, groups, and their index status

group.description: Route to all projects in a group for aggregated index status (requires `codesearch serve`).

project.description: Route to a specific project's index status (requires `codesearch serve`).
